task_intent: Refine Tessera music and creative service connection flows.

mobbin.applied: Separate connected state from available setup and preserve one clear route to the feature.
Pair status with the connected identity; keep management actions attached to that identity.
Give disconnect a visible, direct action and show confirmation at the connection.
Use collection identity and restrained editorial spacing to lead into the canonical shelf.
Keep account actions subordinate to collection content and direct navigation.
Show a recent meaningful item with its timestamp, not decorative fabricated metrics.

primary_sources.applied: Workspace is optional for workspace-scoped keys; multi-workspace keys need an explicit workspace ID. API keys can expire or lose access, so saved credentials never imply successful provider validation.
Workspace field remains collapsed unless needed; help points to Settings, Workspaces.
Discogs Developers account settings is the official destination for generating a token. Collection management remains in the canonical Shelf.

limitations: Discogs developer documentation direct open returned an error; official Discogs account-settings documentation supplied the supported token-generation path.
No real provider key, token, collection, or question was created, removed, or submitted during QA.
Custom line and vinyl illustrations are decorative native Canvas geometry, never album artwork or provider logos.
